description: This file implements the WidevinePlatformDRM class, which provides methods for decrypting media samples using Widevine DRM. It includes constructor and destructor logic, as well as two overloads of the decryptWithHandle method that handle decryption requests, converting handles to secure memory pointers and calling underlying decryption functions.

classes.name: WidevinePlatformDRM
classes.description: A class that provides Widevine DRM decryption functionalities, wrapping handle conversion and decryption calls.

methods.name: WidevinePlatformDRM(widevine::Cdm * cdm)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Widevine platform DRM object.

methods.name: ~WidevinePlatformDRM()
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up the Widevine platform DRM object.

methods.name: widevine::Cdm::Status decryptWithHandle(int32_t handle,const std::string & session_id,const widevine::Cdm::DecryptionBatch & batch)
methods.description: Decrypts a batch of samples using a handle, converting the handle to a secure pointer before calling the underlying decrypt method.

methods.name: widevine::Cdm::Status decryptWithHandle(int32_t handle,const widevine::Cdm::DecryptionBatch & batch)
methods.description: Decryption method overload that also takes a session ID, converting the handle and passing both to the underlying decrypt function.
